items.title_zh: “由建造者签名”：Skyroot 的 Vikram-1 火箭在历史性发射前赢得人心
items.title_en: 'Signed By The People Who Built It': Skyroot's Vikram-1 Rocket Wins Hearts Ahead Of Historic Launch
items.summary_zh: 总理纳伦德拉·莫迪称赞“维克拉姆一号”是印度私营航天领域的里程碑，而社交媒体则赞扬了该任务背后的工程师。
items.summary_en: Prime Minister Narendra Modi hailed Vikram-1 as a milestone for India's private space sector, while social media celebrated the engineers behind the mission.

items.title_en: Louis Vuitton Diaper Goes Viral After Huggies Face-Off, Internet Says 'Now He Can Poop Gold'
items.summary_zh: Instagram 上一条比较 LV 尿布和 Huggies 尿布的视频在网上疯传，在网上引发了争论，社交媒体用户拿奢侈品、育儿和奢侈消费开玩笑
items.summary_en: A viral Instagram reel comparing a LV diaper with a Huggies diaper has sparked debate online, with social media users joking about luxury, parenting and extravagant spending
